residualError.frameGridObservation: The real source onset maps to target frame 9; the false reattack begins at frame 10, exactly one frame later.

diagnosis: The lone corrected false positive is consistent with an onset plateau: the decoder admits every suprathreshold frame as a same-fret reattack. The residual event occurs one frame after a real onset, whereas the observed genuine same-fret reattacks are separated by a return below the attack region and much larger frame gaps.

candidateDecoder.rule: When a note is already active on the same fret, admit a reattack only on a fresh below-to-above onset-threshold crossing. Consecutive suprathreshold onset frames on the same active fret remain one attack.
